text: Six record sleeves from an imagined label, Slow Weather Records. Each grainy gradient is cut into its own shape, and its fine lines draw themselves in and ripple slowly, all six at once.
hint: Hover a sleeve and its lines follow the cursor.
about: Six sleeves for a quiet label.

text: Six tiny 1-bit screens. Every scene is live-dithered through an 8×8 Bayer matrix at 30 fps, with spring parallax under the cursor.
hint: Move across a screen to shift its layers.

text: An identity board for an imagined coastal listening station. Seabed sections, a card on a visible grid and a depth readout that surfaces words on the way down.
hint: Watch the sounding line drop and the words surface.

text: An identity board for an imagined institute that runs the same small life again and again. Colonies of cells grow in, the clock counts down, and at zero everything grows back almost the same.
hint: Wait for the clock to reach zero, or move across a colony to make it sprout.

text: Four sheets from the register of an imagined lost property office, left on a desk. Open one and what was written into it types itself in, the highlighter goes across and the stamp comes down.
hint: Click a sheet to open it and watch it being written; press a tab to lift its sheet.

text: Four sheets of French New Wave paperwork: a subtitle file, a contact sheet, a page of script and a shooting note. The French on each sheet is what was said; whatever looks through it finds an English line that does not quite agree.
hint: Move over a sheet and its lens, frames, viewfinder or note follows you. Click a sheet to see it full size.

text: Four squares of kasuri cloth for films by Ozu, Naruse and Kore-eda, each with a woven label carrying the one line someone said out loud. Washed, the cloth creases and the label rewrites itself into what was meant.
about: What goes unsaid, in the wash.
hint: Rest the pointer on a cloth and wait for the wash. Click one to see it full size.

text: A torn paper collage of what the Galactic Railroad might have left in the ground: bone chips, a sand of stars, a dark hole with amber at its floor, a railway that breaks off, feathers falling onto a river. When it comes into view everything moves together for a few seconds, then settles.
about: Paper left by a starlit railway.
hint: Rest the cursor on the bone chips and they crumble; the powder washes into the river.

text: A repair ticket, a laundry slip and two tags, left at the counters in one week and gathered into a small stack. Open one and it is written again, field by field, until the day is circled by hand.
about: Tickets for things left to mend.
hint: Click a ticket to open it and watch it being filled in.

text: Four small piles of torn and cut paper, left on one desk on the last night of a town paper: the newspaper office, the ferry, the bakery, a letter not sent. Open one and it squares itself up, and the last line of every slip, read down the edge, makes one sentence no paper printed.
hint: Click a pile to open it and watch it square up; read down the edges.

text: Three posters for an imagined New Zealand drinks house that sends its drinks and wine out like post. Open any one and its brand book comes up: twelve landscape pages, each setting itself as it opens.
about: A brand book for drinks that take the long way.
hint: Click a poster to open the brand book, then turn its pages.

text: A four-level house on a hillside by the sea, built in Blender and rendered in Cycles, presented like a headset launch. Open it and the interface comes up: one wide window bent round you, floors on one side, views on the other, the whole house on a small desk close at hand.
about: A house by the sea, as a headset sees it.
hint: Open any sheet to step into the house: choose where to begin, then walk it floor by floor.
